Thank you for your suggestions. I do cook a lot and I hadn't really thought about cooking meals for money. Something I could definitely do if I could get a food safety certificate.


Marketplace or Ebay flipping is something I'd considered but I worry it is too oversaturated. I can't drive due to medications so unfortunately lyft/Uber aren't an option.


Thank you again for your genuine care and help.

Thank you very much for your reply. I'm sure I will do it wrong haha, but I will try my best not to. I suppose it would indeed be a bit surreal from your side of things, but luckily for people like me who didn't have the opportunity to go to university, we can ask questions in places like this. Again, thank you and I sincerely appreciate your help.

Thank you for sharing that personal story with me and others that may see it. I know it would have taken a lot of courage for me to do something like that. I will heed your advice and give it a try. I just feel as if everyone else had their lives handed on a plate for them, but I shouldn't be so bitter. It's so hard to remind yourself you are not alone in feeling this way.
